corrections.was: 1 B = 8 b; a bit is written b
corrections.now: 1 B = 8 bit; the standard symbol for the bit is "bit", b is a common shorthand
corrections.source: D3 (NIST binary prefixes page: 1 B = 2^3 bit = 8 bit; 1 kbit = 1000 bit)

corrections.was: CHAR_BIT is the number of bits in the smallest C++ unit of storage
corrections.now: the number of bits in one C++ byte; C++ leaves that number to each compiler

corrections.was: The processor moves several bytes together when it loads a word
corrections.now: the processor can move several bytes together, e.g. RISC-V LH loads a 16-bit value
